title: V1 promoted from future trigger to executable child plan
body: The parent roadmap originally held V1 until both a static dashboard prerequisite and demand signal fired. The operator explicitly requested completing the roadmap by building out subplans and implementing through the orchestrator. That request is the demand signal and operator override. This child plan opens V1 now, while preserving the V2 boundary as a separate child plan.

title: Static dashboard owns Capability Center before Firebase realtime
body: Capability Center must live in the static/core dashboard, not the Firebase realtime adapter. Otherwise the operator would need Firebase configured before seeing the view that explains Firebase setup. F001 therefore targets dashboard/index.html + static page modules and state JSON first.

title: MCP projection is read-only in V1
body: V1 may expose capability status to agents through MCP, but setup/mutation remains out of scope. Guided setup belongs to V2 with confirm gates and evidence. This keeps V1 reviewable and avoids mixing visual/read-only projection with governed setup execution.
